description: This file defines the SystemCheckAPI class within the OrangeHRM installer component, specifically handling system check API requests during installation or system upgrade. It extends another API class and customizes the GET request handling to include additional system checks related to data encryption permissions.

classes.name: SystemCheckAPI
classes.description: A PHP class that extends the base SystemCheckAPI to add additional system checks specific to the installer process, particularly checking for write permissions in the cryptographic keys directory when data encryption is enabled.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Overrides the parent handleGet method to include additional system checks related to data encryption permissions if data encryption is enabled in the system configuration.
